correctness.rationale: Exact definition excludes one backward arc and both possible directed cycles. Matching by forward-arc fibers leaves a finite upward filter of backward dominating sets plus a top sphere cell; acyclicity on the filter and all critical faces were exhaustively checked by standalone code for every 4<=n<=20 (164172 states, 1070871 directed Hasse edges), cross-checked against independent direct complex construction at n=4..10. A simplicial retraction onto the full-forward sphere gives a primitive top class; for n>=6 relative Hurewicz kills the high attaching map, n=5 has no lower cell and n=4 has an explicit elementary decomposition. No inference to untested n is made.
